g.text: THE FIVE THAT CHANGED WHAT THE PAPER CAN CLAIM

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #141413

g.text: With mass fixed and diameter free, the optimum was a heat shield heavier than the vehicle

g.text: The nose-radius lever has no ceiling in the model, so the front sits on a placeholder

g.text: The physics changed under a live study, and nothing in the runner noticed

g.text: The honesty record: 35 negative results, every one kept

g.text: Numbered in the order they were found, grouped by what broke. The five that changed what the paper can claim are called out.

g.text: In most cases a plausible, well-formatted, wrong answer was available.

g.text: The grouping by kind is this figure's reading of each entry (the paper's §17 groups them by consequence); the five call-outs are the ones §17 and §8.2 build on. Squares outlined in ink = called out.
